summary: PR #28 fully implements issue #9 (Orquestracao do subprocesso Python) with all acceptance criteria met. All 31 tests pass, type checking passes, linting passes. Implementation establishes Node.js as single entry point by spawning FastAPI Python audio server in background on app.whenReady(), waits for GPU model confirmation via stdout detection before activating microphone IPC handlers, and properly cleans up Python subprocess via will-quit handler with SIGTERM + variable nullification. Code organization standards met: files cohesive (scripts/spawn-python-server.ts 57 lines after fix), splits by responsibility, no fragmentation. Security model respected: process isolation, localhost-only binding, IPC contract enforced via contextBridge, timeout protection (30s). Edge cases handled: Python binary detection fallback chain, process error/close events, cleanup for already-terminated subprocesses, TypeError handling. Known limitations documented (port conflicts, orphan processes on kill -9, GPU memory persistence) with mitigations. Quality improvement made: removed duplicate export default from spawn-python-server.ts to clarify named export usage pattern.
reviewedAreas: Main process lifecycle contract (spawnPythonServerLogic awaited in whenReady handler at main.ts:108-124)
GPU model detection via stdout marker parsing (scripts/spawn-python-server.ts:36-45, main.ts:57-66)
Startup fail-fast on GPU load failure (main.ts:116-118)
IPC handlers exposed to renderer (python-status-request, python-pid at preload/index.ts:8-9)
Shutdown cleanup handler (will-quit calls process.kill with SIGTERM, nullifies refs at main.ts:206-218)
Python detection and environment variables (PYTHON_CMD, KOKORO_MODEL_PATH documented)
Error handling throughout (timeout protection, process.exit code checks, TypeError catching)
Test coverage (31 tests across 4 test suites all passing)
Type checking (tsc --noEmit passes with no errors)
Linting (eslint . --ext ts,tsx passes with no warnings)
Code organization (files split by responsibility, reasonable size, no fragmentation)
Security model (process isolation, localhost binding, IPC contract enforcement)
Known limitations documented in PR (orphan processes, port conflicts, GPU memory persistence)
Acceptance criteria verification (all 3 criteria marked complete)

blockers.impact: duplicate export default conflicted with named export on line 13 - would confuse consumers and violate code organization standards
blockers.fix: Removed duplicate export default statement. Consumers use named export spawnPythonServer() as intended.

fixes: TypeScript compilation error in spawn-python-server.ts resolved by removing duplicate default export

residualRisks: Orphan Python process on kill -9 crash (mitigation: user can pkill manually)
Port 1234 conflict if another service is running (mitigation: future enhancement to use env var)
GPU memory not released after app quit (mitigation: add SIGKILL fallback or requirements.txt)
No health check endpoint for readiness polling (current GPU marker approach sufficient for single-instance)
